## busted checkin
```{r, busted checkin}

library(jsonlite)

J <- fromJSON("FMO1_BUSTED.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("fmo1_bustedEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

###pull 8num cols comp to csv
U <- J$fits[["Unconstrained model"]][["Rate Distributions"]][["Test"]]
json_vals <- c(
  lrt = J[["test results"]][["LRT"]],
  pval = J[["test results"]][["p-value"]],
  omega_purifying = U[["0"]]$omega,
  omega_neutral = U[["1"]]$omega,
  omega_positive = U[["2"]]$omega,
  proportion_purifying = U[["0"]]$proportion,
  proportion_neutral = U[["1"]]$proportion,
  proportion_positive = U[["2"]]$proportion
  )

csv_vals <- unlist(csv[1, names(json_vals)])

###compare w/small tolerance, csv/float rounding unsafe for exact
print(data.frame(json = json_vals, csv = csv_vals,
                 match = abs(json_vals - csv_vals) < 1e-8))

####gene col is constant str
cat("gene match =", all(csv$gene == "FMO1"), "\n")

###the fits_* cols req parse of embedded JSON, compare omega/proportion
##organize df of class/omega/prop
con <- fromJSON(csv$fits_constrained_test[1])    
unc <- fromJSON(csv$fits_unconstrained_test[1])
C <- J$fits[["Constrained model"]][["Rate Distributions"]][["Test"]]
cat("fits_constrained_test match =",
    all(abs(con$omega - sapply(C, `[[`, "omega")) < 1e-8) &&
    all(abs(con$proportion - sapply(C, `[[`, "proportion")) < 1e-8), "\n")
cat("fits_unconstrained_test match =",
    all(abs(unc$omega - sapply(U, `[[`, "omega")) < 1e-8) &&
    all(abs(unc$proportion - sapply(U, `[[`, "proportion")) < 1e-8), "\n")

####per-part cols incl branches/part idx/codon range
for (i in seq_len(nrow(csv))) {
  p <- as.character(csv$partition[i])
  tb <- unlist(J$tested[[p]])
  cov <- unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]][["coverage"]])
  cat(sprintf("partition %s: index match = %s | branches match = %s | codon range match = %s\n",
              p,
              csv$partition[i] == as.integer(p),
              setequal(fromJSON(csv$branches[i]), names(tb)[tb == "test"]),
              identical(sprintf("%d-%d", min(cov), max(cov)), csv$partition_codon_range[i])))
}

##clear on 14 bustedeh cols
```
